description: Request changes on a PR. Records a 'changes requested' review by the caller, which holds the PR on every merge path (web button, API, MCP merge, merge queue, merge train, autopilot) until the caller approves or someone with write access dismisses it (gluecron_dismiss_review), and posts the body as a comment. Requires 'repo' scope and write access.
name: gluecron_request_changes
